decision.summary: Tom gave one month's notice (to leave 10 Nov); under the Renters' Rights Act two months is needed, so the earliest valid end is 10 Dec 2026. I replied to him, asked the landlord whether he will agree in writing to 10 Nov, and scheduled the move-out work against 10 Dec.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? What is the earliest end date under current law?
answers.answer: No. One month is too short; tenants must give 2 months' written notice. Notice received 10 Oct 2026, so earliest end is 10 Dec 2026.

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Only the landlord agreeing in writing to an earlier date (e.g. 10 Nov), or a surrender agreed by both sides; also a replacement tenant if the landlord agrees. Landlord asked.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied acknowledging notice, giving 10 Dec as the valid date, keys handed at checkout (details to follow), deposit returned via mydeposits after checkout. Started: landlord question, follow-up on 14 Oct, checkout/key-return follow-up on 1 Dec.

assumptions: Notice treated as served on 10 Oct 2026 by email; keys to be returned to the agency at checkout.

args.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for your email of 10 October. We've received your notice and I'm sorry to see you go, but congratulations on the new job.

Under the current rules a tenant needs to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough. Counting from today, the earliest valid end date is 10 December 2026. Rent stays payable until then. You asked to leave on 10 November: we've asked your landlord whether they'll agree to that in writing. Until they say yes, please plan on 10 December. We'll tell you their answer by Wednesday 14 October.

What happens next:
- Checkout: we'll arrange a checkout inspection around your end date and give you at least 24 hours' notice of the time.
- Keys: all sets should be handed back to us at the checkout visit. We'll confirm exactly where and when in that notice. Please don't post them or leave them at the flat.
- Deposit: your £2,019 deposit is protected with mydeposits. After checkout, any proposed deductions are agreed with you, or decided by the scheme's free dispute service if we can't agree. It's returned within 10 days of agreement.

Best wishes,
Mare & Co Lettings
